title: make_random_timing.py
description: Create random stimulus timing files for use with AFNI 3dDeconvolve.

run_time.description: Set the total time per run (in seconds).
run_time.title: Run Time (seconds)

num_stim.description: Set the number of stimulus classes.
num_stim.title: Number of Stimulus Classes

num_reps.description: Set the number of repetitions per class (or across runs).
num_reps.title: Number of Repetitions

prefix.description: Set the prefix for output filenames.
prefix.title: Output Filename Prefix

stim_dur.description: Set the duration for a single stimulus (in seconds).
stim_dur.title: Stimulus Duration

across_runs.description: Distribute stimuli across all runs at once.
across_runs.title: Distribute Stimuli Across Runs

max_consec.description: Specify maximum consecutive stimuli per class.
max_consec.title: Maximum Consecutive Stimuli

min_rest.description: Specify extra rest after each stimulus.
min_rest.title: Minimum Rest

not_first.description: Specify classes that should not start a run.
not_first.title: Classes Not to Start a Run

not_last.description: Specify classes that should not end a run.
not_last.title: Classes Not to End a Run

offset.description: Specify an offset to add to every stim time.
offset.title: Time Offset

ordered_stimuli.description: Specify a partial ordering of stimuli.
ordered_stimuli.title: Ordered Stimuli

pre_stim_rest.description: Specify minimum rest period to start each run.
pre_stim_rest.title: Pre-Stimulus Rest

post_stim_rest.description: Specify minimum rest period to end each run.
post_stim_rest.title: Post-Stimulus Rest

seed.description: Specify a seed for random number generation.
seed.title: Random Seed

stim_labels.description: Specify labels for the stimulus classes.
stim_labels.title: Stimulus Labels

t_digits.description: Set the number of decimal places for times.
t_digits.title: Decimal Places for Times

tr_locked.description: Make stimuli timing locked to the accompanying TR.
tr_locked.title: TR-Locked
